en.bdb: The fool does not chant the Name of the Lord.
en.ms: The ignorant man utters not the Lord's Name.

en.ms: Then, what is it that he deliberates upon over and over again. Pause.

en.ms: I have found the incomprehensible thing,

en.bdb: my mind is illuminated and enlightened. ||2||
en.ms: as within my mind the lamp go gnosis is aflame.

en.ms: Says Kabir, now I know the Lord;

pu.ss: ਕਬੀਰ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ—ਉਸ ਅਪਹੰੁਚ ਹਰਿ-ਨਾਮ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੀ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ ਹੋ ਗਈ ਹੈ

en.bdb: since I know Him, my mind is pleased and appeased.
en.ms: when I know Him, then is my mind pleased.

pu.ss: ਜਦੋਂ ਤੋਂ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਉਸੇ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਪਰਚ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ।

en.bdb: My mind is pleased and appeased, and yet, people do not believe it.
en.ms: My mind is pleased, but people believe it not;

en.bdb: They do not believe it, so what can I do? ||3||7||
en.ms: If they believe not what can I then do?
